description: This file declares the Pause class, which is a task for pausing a Web Audio player within the Rialto server component. It includes class definitions, constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references external interfaces for Web Audio player client and private implementations.

classes.name: Pause
classes.description: A class representing a task to pause the Web Audio player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pause task with references to the player and client.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pause operation on the Web Audio player.
